name: faf001_GetTasksPage
description: Read one filtered page of caller-accessible tasks. This Action does not modify data.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_GetTasksPage.faf001_ProcessInstanceId
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Optional process-instance GUID. Omit to include all accessible instances.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_GetTasksPage.faf001_Status
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Optional integer BP Task Status choice value, not the built-in state or status reason.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_GetTasksPage.faf001_AssignedUserId
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Optional systemuser GUID. Combined with Assigned Team using OR; does not change caller identity.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_GetTasksPage.faf001_AssignedTeamId
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Optional team GUID. Combined with Assigned User using OR; does not grant access.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_GetTasksPage.faf001_PageSize
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Optional integer from 1 to 500. Defaults to 100. Repeat the same effective size on subsequent pages.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_GetTasksPage.faf001_ContinuationToken
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Opaque token from the previous response. Repeat the same filters. Omit or send an empty string to start.

CustomAPIResponseProperties.name: faf001_GetTasksPage.faf001_Tasks
CustomAPIResponseProperties.description: One page of caller-accessible faf001_bptask rows with the documented task columns.

CustomAPIResponseProperties.name: faf001_GetTasksPage.faf001_HasMore
CustomAPIResponseProperties.description: True when Dataverse reports another page. Paging is not a point-in-time snapshot.

CustomAPIResponseProperties.name: faf001_GetTasksPage.faf001_NextToken
CustomAPIResponseProperties.description: Continuation token for the next request, or an empty string on the last page.
